id: title:Gilbert09:add paymongo payout transactions subscriptions and invoices

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Payout Transactions, Subscriptions, and Invoices support to the PayMongo connector, enabling warehouse ingestion of nested transaction details for reconciliation and accounting.
review.reason: The observed change P1.F6.H3 adds Payout Transactions, Subscriptions, and Invoices to the PayMongo connector, including metadata and parent-child relationships. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for warehouse ingestion and accounting reconciliation. No tier assignment requested.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed code addition, but the actual operational benefit and adoption are not independently verified; the tier assumes the connector implementation is complete and relevant, while the PR description and comments are treated as untrusted and not used for scoring.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single conservative group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.
